lines.beaver: 수진 씨 소식 들었어요? 요즘 어떻대요?
lines.beaver_en: Did you hear about Sujin? How is she these days?
lines.beaver_roman: Sujin ssi sosik deureosseoyo? Yojeum eotteotaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 요즘 아주 신났대요. 얼굴에 미소가 가득해요.
lines.en: Yes, she says she's really excited lately. She's all smiles.
lines.roman: Ne, yojeum aju sinnatdaeyo. Eolgure misoga gadeukaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? She was upset last week, though.
lines.en: Right. She says she was so upset she just kept sighing.

lines.learner: 발표 때 실수해서 창피했대요. 자기가 미웠대요.
lines.en: She made a mistake in her presentation and was embarrassed. She says she hated herself.
lines.roman: Balpyo ttae silsuhaeseo changpihaetdaeyo. Jagiga miwotdaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, that must have been hard.
lines.en: She says she got scared and got tired of studying too.

lines.beaver_en: So how did she start feeling better?
lines.en: She says a movie she saw on the weekend really moved her.

lines.beaver_en: What did she say about the movie?
lines.en: She says it was really touching. She cried a lot watching it.
She says it's a story about a kid who's afraid of the dark.

lines.beaver_en: So that's how Sujin got her strength back.
lines.learner: 네, 이제 다시 힘이 났대요. 정말 다행이에요.
lines.en: Yes, she says she's got her energy back. What a relief.
lines.roman: Ne, ije dasi himi natdaeyo. Jeongmal dahaengieyo.

lines.beaver: 수진 씨 요즘 다른 고민은 없대요?
lines.beaver_en: Does Sujin have any other worries these days?
lines.beaver_roman: Sujin ssi yojeum dareun gomineun eopdaeyo?
lines.en: She says her worry is that her feelings change often.

lines.beaver: 그렇군요. 오늘 같이 만날 수 있대요?
lines.beaver_en: I see. Did she say she can meet up today?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureokunnyo. Oneul gachi mannal su itdaeyo?
lines.learner: 아쉽지만 오늘은 시험이래요. 다음 주에 봐요!
lines.en: Too bad, she says she has an exam today. Let's meet next week!
lines.roman: Aswipjiman oneureun siheomiraeyo. Daeum jue bwayo!
